🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: (1) Broad sector-level strength in Energy, Utilities and Healthcare with multiple ABOVE TREND names (XOM (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +10.49%) ABOVE TREND; CVX (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +11.84%) ABOVE TREND), and (2) large-cap Tech and select Financials show material divergences with many BELOW TREND (NVDA (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -5.21%) BELOW TREND; GOOGL (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -9.38%) BELOW TREND), so style mixed / no clear leadership; Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +10.49%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +11.84%) ABOVE TREND. Communication strong: NFLX (1W: +27.72% | 1M: +16.75%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +9.35% | 1M: -10.61%) RECOVERY. Technology showing upside momentum but mixed placement: INTU (1W: +16.55% | 1M: -16.68%) RECOVERY, CRM (1W: +8.30% | 1M: -9.87%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Staples lagging: EL (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -12.76%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: +? | 1M: +?) — data limited for some names; Consumer Discretionary soft: LOW (1W: -6.27% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: +7.98% | 1M: -18.26%) RECOVERY shows idiosyncratic bounce. Materials mixed with pockets of CORRECTION: PPG (1W: -4.91% | 1M: +2.90%) CORRECTION.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +27.72% | 1M: +16.75%) ABOVE TREND; INTU (1W: +16.55% | 1M: -16.68%) RECOVERY; CEG (1W: +11.35% | 1M: +13.81%) ABOVE TREND; PLTR (1W: +11.16% | 1M: -4.41%) RECOVERY; TTWO (1W: +9.35% | 1M: -10.61%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Moderate concentration (Top 5 span Communication, Technology, Utilities).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: LLY (1W: -3.83% | 1M: -0.44%) BELOW TREND; ASML (1W: -4.20% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND; MNST (1W: -4.29% | 1M: +1.27%) CORRECTION; AXP (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -14.25%) BELOW TREND; TXN (1W: -4.57% | 1M: -4.18%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Technology and select defensives.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: NFLX (1W: +27.72% | 1M: +16.75%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +16.55% | 1M: -16.68%) RECOVERY, CEG (1W: +11.35% | 1M: +13.81%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +11.16% | 1M: -4.41%) RECOVERY, TTWO (1W: +9.35% | 1M: -10.61%) RECOVERY. Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps (multiple majors have 1W ≠ 1M) — tactical moves, not broad confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology: internal rotation—1W strength (+2.56%) but 1M weakness (-8.63%). NVDA (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -5.21%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: +3.66% | 1M: -7.85%) RECOVERY, INTU (1W: +16.55% | 1M: -16.68%) RECOVERY; sector is selective and reliant on idiosyncratic winners.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials: mixed/rotation with 1W mild positive (+0.28%) and 1M weakness (-4.61%). JPM (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -2.89%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +4.56% | 1M: -3.20%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +5.03% | 1M: -4.18%) RECOVERY — payments and select banks showing short-term momentum amid broader softness.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare: resilient with 1W +0.60% and 1M +4.82%; defensive names leading. JNJ (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +0.90%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: -3.83% | 1M: -0.44%) BELOW TREND — sector strength but a few idiosyncratic laggards.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select Healthcare and monitor large-cap Tech for confirmation; reduce exposure to names clearly BELOW TREND (NVDA (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -5.21%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -12.76%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given strong sector breadth but major-cap divergence; treat rallies in RECOVERY names as tactical.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +27.72% | 1M: +16.75%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.82% | 1M: +19.99%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +10.49%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -5.21%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -12.76%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -4.20% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.67% | 1M: +14.28%) Sector Strength; Healthcare (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +4.82%) showing defensive flows. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (1W: -1.39% | 1M: +6.75%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -2.66%) remain sources of downside risk for cyclicals.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: needs sustained weekly closes above recent swing highs to alleviate BELOW TREND pressure. AAPL (1W: -0.55% | 1M: +2.59%) CORRECTION — watch 1W support area for follow-through. XOM (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +10.49%) ABOVE TREND — keep an eye on breakout continuation above recent highs.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BKNG (+60): Q4 earnings beat and analyst upgrade; BKNG (1W: +7.98% | 1M: -18.26%) RECOVERY — short-term sentiment confirming price bounce but long-term weakness remains. (Limited cross-ref coverage for other high-sentiment names in feed.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CVX (-50): Leviathan shutdown headline weighing on sentiment; CVX (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +11.84%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headlines diverge from price, signaling distribution risk to monitor. (Several names show mixed sentiment coverage; treat headlines as catalysts, watch price confirmation.)

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. NFLX (1W: +27.72% | 1M: +16.75%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +10.49%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps (NVDA, GOOGL BELOW TREND vs Energy/Healthcare ABOVE TREND) and mixed news flow (e.g., CVX headline negative while price remains ABOVE TREND) — watch for trend breaks rather than assuming broad regime shift.
